title: Verify: App header round states unit tests
summary: Tests for loaded, loading and error header states.
description: Mock api client and assert header states.
acceptance_criteria: Loaded, loading and error states asserted.
World title shown in the header is asserted.
technical_constraints: vi.mock('../src/api/client') for getCurrentRound; fixture shape matches Round in game/frontend/src/api/client.ts (served by backend GET /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current)

steps.action: Create jsdom test file; mock ../src/api/client getCurrentRound with a Round-typed object built per the Round interface (fixture constant in the file). Render App, click Begin. Tests: (1) resolved -> await findByText of round id and status; (2) never-resolving promise -> getByText('Loading round…'); (3) rejects Error('boom') -> findByRole('alert') has text 'Round unavailable: boom'; (4) world title "The Boy's Room" shown in header.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appHeader.test.tsx
